title: Approval card: keep `x stop` on the hint line when `p report` shows
lead: On the approval-card pane the hint line shows `p report` and drops `x stop`. The owner wants `x stop` kept, since stopping a run at the approval card must stay one key away. *Proposed.*
findings_note: S227 item 6 (from S176 later notes); the owner flagged it as a priority and asked on 2026-11-07 for it to go in v1.1

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- The hint line drops entries in a fixed order when the width is short (`internal/tui/keys.go:253-278`). On the approval card `p report` displaces `x stop`.
- It is a UX regression the owner marked a priority (S227 note).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- A golden view of the approval card at 80x24 shows both `p report` and `x stop` on the hint line.
- At narrower widths the drop order keeps `x stop` and drops other hints first.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. At start, re-anchor the lines above against the code and find where the approval card builds its hint line.
2. Change the drop order so `x stop` outlasts `p report`.
3. Update `docs/dashboard.md` and the golden views (`go test ./internal/tui -update`, then review the diff).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l .`, `slicer check`, `adj lint`.
- UI pass (rule u10): this slice changes `internal/tui` and its golden views.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: - Branch and worktree per AGENTS.md; no commit until the owner approves.
